q: we have a truce with the Fins at the moment
w: Re-ruled at B4a-06 under J's answer to QB4-003: themes a reader listed under its own also_present count in the bag test. Corrected after packet 6's last chunk, when b4_bag_named_check.py showed reading A's named T3-050 left unweighed. Reading A placed T3-150 with a bag, reader B T3-149 with a bag. 'Someone needs to ask them to spare us. EDIT: Done.', 'we have a truce with the Fins at the moment', 'We have a truce with the Vikings. Would have one with yours as well' and 'the void threatens us both so lets save this talk for later' make and keep truces (T3-149, reader B and my B1), seven concepts, the largest act; it is the bag's placed theme. 'Looks like Chicago has to collaborate' and the plan to 'attack the Packers logo' with the Vikings and Lions form alliances (T3-150, reading A), four. Of the readers' named themes, the Wild logo 'we don't plan on overlapping', the move of a pixel or two, Finland's 'Thats not gonna happen' and the permission requested settle space (T3-010), four; Finland 'building a new logo for you at 200,870', 'We are trying to remedy the situation', the offer to rebuild elsewhere and 'putting ours there to make it up to us' turn the attackers into helpers (T3-119), four; 'fuck the Finns', '/r/psu sends their regards.' and the call to 'change the Packers G to a Georgia G!' taunt rival rooms (T3-050), three; 'this is how they repay us', 'the Fins have betrayed us' and 'It's hard to trust you all the second time' dispute the alliance (T3-030), three; 'to destroy others work is not right' and the two answers about wiped-out carrots argue whether covering is fair (T3-046), three; the welcome to the 'Bears-Finland synthesis', 'future Finn-Chicagoan relations' and the thanks to the Finnish ambassador greet the other room (T3-122), three. 'Yeah they hate Finland so much that they visit that place' mocks a claim of hatred and taunts no rival. Nine themes reach three concepts, so the item is a bag. Content named: 'Finland is cancer', 'fuck the Finns'.
